title: Milling machines

about_title: Milling machines for the toolroom and the fabrication shop
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification by a maker that exports metalworking machinery to more than 70 countries, inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel on every 3-phase machine, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

Milling machines cut flat faces, slots, steps, pockets and keyways with rotating cutters while the table moves the work under them: knee-type turret mills with a horizontal spindle as well as the vertical head, universal mills with a head that swivels through 360°, heavy ISO50 universal mills with power feed and rapid traverse on all axes and tables up to 79″, drilling-milling machines that drill 2″, a mini mill-drill and a radial drill-mill, a keyseater and a slotting machine for keyways and splines, and the KSM-850 resurfacing machine for cylinder heads and blocks.
